title: Consultor SAP FSCM
description:
*Consultor SAP FSCM - 13675*

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto

Horário de Trabalho: comercial

Remuneração: enviar pretensão salarial PJ

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um Consultor Sênior SAP FICO altamente qualificado e experiente, com especialização nos processos de Record to Report (RTR). O candidato ideal desempenhará um papel fundamental no suporte e aprimoramento das operações financeiras por meio dos módulos SAP FICO garantindo conformidade, precisão e eficiência nos relatórios financeiros e nas práticas contábeis.

Conhecimentos e Competências Necessárias:

5+ anos de experiência com SAP S/4HANA

1+ implementação completa de ciclo (full lifecycle) envolvendo Gestão de Contas a Receber (Receivables Management)

Experiência prática em configuração de:

Segmentos de crédito, scoring, automação de limite de crédito e workflows de DCD

Estratégias de cobrança, listas de trabalho (worklists), regras e correspondências

Categorias de casos de disputa, workflows, anotações e processos de resolução

Forte entendimento da integração com os processos SAP FI e SD

Experiência com melhorias (enhancements) para verificações de crédito, pedidos bloqueados e lógica customizada relacionada a crédito

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, documentação e troubleshooting

Responsabilidades :

Trabalhar com as áreas de Finanças e Order-to-Cash para levantar e documentar requisitos. Realizar configuração, testes e implantação dos processos de FSCM nas áreas de crédito, cobranças e disputas. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de RTR, OTC e técnicas para melhorar a automação, reduzir esforços manuais e aprimorar a gestão de contas a receber.

Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante a entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Software Pleno
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Atuar como analista de desenvolvimento em uma das Squads dos produtos TOTVS RH (linha RM), assegurando a qualidade das entregas do time a fim de que os requisitos de software

solicitados pelo PO sejam atendidos.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolvimento, testes e documentação de features de inovação, legislação e manutenção nos produtos TOTVS RH, utilizando tecnologias c#.Net, ASP.NET e Angular em arquitetura N camadas.
  • Aplicar inovações incrementais nos sistemas legados.
  • Trabalhar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de RH, com intuito de melhorar a experiência de nossos produtos para nossos clientes;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a Squad conforme os processos ágeis definidos pela empresa, com objetivo de atingir as metas do time;
  • Garantir que as entregas estão em conformidade com as boas práticas e convenções internas;
  • Desenvolver Testes Unitários, Testes Automatizados e Documentar funcionalidades desenvolvidas.
  • Orientar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação superior em andamento/completa área de tecnologia e afins;
  • Experiência com a linguagem de programação C#;
  • Boa lógica de programação e POO;
  • Conhecimento em HTML/CSS;
  • Conhecimento em JavaScript/TypeScript;
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados;
  • Processo Ágil;
  • Boas práticas de programação, princípios SOLID;
  • Desejável Experiência nos produtos TOTVS RM.
  • Banco de Dados – nível intermediário;

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Vestiário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

#Ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS

title: Banco de Talentos - Engenharia CAE/FEA
description:
Descrição da empresa

A ÅF Automotive faz parte do grupo AFRY que é um dos mais populares empregadores da Suécia, somos mais de 17 mil consultores em todo o mundo. Atuamos no Brasil desde 2013 na área de Engenharia Automotiva em diversas montadoras no Brasil, e clientes na Suécia e EUA. Nossa sede está localizada em São Bernardo do Campo/SP e a filial em Curitiba/PR. Nós nos preocupamos em fazer o futuro, venha fazer parte dessa história!

New brand. ÅF and Pöyry come together as AFRY. We are 17,000 devoted experts, brave enough to stand up for what we believe in #Making Future

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos profissionais com experiência no setor Automotivo.

  • Realizar simulações FEA para soluções técnicas, utilizando Hypermesh ou similares e seguindo diretrizes do cliente;
  • Realizar análises estruturais utilizando método de elementos finitos;

Requisitos

  • Disponibilidade de trabalhar presencialmente em Curitiba
  • Inglês - Avançado
  • Espanhol é um diferencial
  • Conhecimento básico e experiência com análise FEA. Hyperworks (Hypermesh, hyperview, optistruct) é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento básico de modelo CAD.
  • Conhecimento avançado na ferramenta Excel.
  • Cursando ou recém formado em áreas correlatas da Engenharia

title: Analytics, AI and Data Scientist
description:
Remoov is a fast-growing startup that is enabling the circular economy. We are unlocking the value of the $100B used goods industry by removing the friction of upcycling your items, reducing waste by increasing reuse!. We operate in the intersection of tech-enabled operations and sales automation.

Our Stack:

Postgres, Python, Metabase, PostHog, scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, matplotlib, seaborn

Why work with us:

  • Ability to work remotely with a distributed team
  • A small team that loves to learn and experiment
  • Exposure to modern technologies
  • Opportunity to make a real impact in the company's direction and growth

What we are looking for:

  • Strong foundation of Python
  • Practical knowledge of Git
  • Strong problem solving ability and analytical skills
  • Entrepreneurial spirit
  • Conversational in English
  • We are looking for candidates in Brazil or able to speak Portuguese

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze data and build models to improve the business operations
  • Build dashboards and reports to help the business make data-driven decisions
  • Run A/B testing and data experiments to validate hypothesis
  • Develop data pipeline, statistical modeling, and collaborate on model deployment
  • Design, develop and maintain secure, stable, scalable, and extensible solutions

Compensation Brazilian real 12,000 - 15,000 BRL per month + 0.02% equity in the company.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Key Account Manager | Híbrido - Pinheiros, São Paulo - SP

Estamos assessorando uma logtech em expansão na América Latina, dedicada a transformar a logística do e-commerce em vantagem competitiva. Sua principal missão é ajudar marcas digitais a escalarem suas operações através de uma solução de fulfillment completa.

Buscamos um (a) Key Account Manager, para ser o (a) guardião de sucesso dos clientes estratégicos da marca.

Sua missão será assumir o bastão após o onboarding, garantindo que a operação não apenas funcione, mas escale com qualidade e visão estratégica.

Principais Atividades

  • Gestão de Relacionamento: Ser o ponto focal dos principais stakeholders, garantindo confiança e continuidade após a implementação;
  • Excelência Operacional: Monitorar KPIs e SLAs críticos (Nível de serviço, Churn, Backlog) e liderar QBRs e checkpoints de performance;
  • Interface Cross-functional: Orquestrar demandas entre os times de Produto, Operações, Financeiro e Suporte para resolver gargalos e crises;
  • Crescimento da Conta: Identificar oportunidades de expansão (Upsell/Cross-sell) e apoiar renegociações contratuais;
  • Voz do Cliente: Transformar feedbacks reais em melhorias diretas nos nossos processos e políticas internas.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida na gestão de contas de médio e grande porte;
  • Perfil analítico: você deve \"falar a língua\" dos indicadores operacionais;
  • Habilidade de negociação e resiliência para gestão de crises;
  • Domínio intermediário de Excel/Google Sheets;
  • Diferencial: Background em Logística, Fulfillment, SaaS ou Marketplaces, além de familiaridade com métricas como LTV, CAC e GMV.

-Modelo de atuação híbrido, sendo 3x por semana presenciais em Pinheiros, São Paulo.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior AWS
description:
Oportunidade de atuação em projeto — Engenheiro de Dados Sênior (AWS)

Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA, com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks, atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida, com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.

Contexto do projeto:

Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuação em projeto na área de Dados, em um de nossos maiores clientes, com foco em Engenharia de Dados voltada a AWS, por meio de contrato PJ.

Perfil Técnico Esperado:

  • Experiência prática com data lakes, data mesh e serviços da AWS, incluindo Amazon Web Services (AWS Glue, Kinesis, Redshift, Athena, Aurora e S3).
  • Capacidade de desenvolver APIs e implementar soluções utilizando PySpark em ambientes como Databricks e EMR.
  • Experiência na configuração e otimização de recursos e clusters na AWS.
  • Desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de pipelines de dados, incluindo arquitetura Lambda.
  • Estruturação e gestão de arquitetura de dados em múltiplas camadas (raw, bronze, silver e gold).
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica e condução de sessões de transferência de conhecimento (KT) das soluções implementadas.
  • Vivência em ambientes que adotam metodologias ágeis como Scrum, Kanban e Lean.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações da AWS: Certified Data Engineer – Associate.

Escopo de Atuação:

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir pipelines de dados conforme demandas do projeto.
  • Estruturar e aprimorar a arquitetura de dados (camadas raw, bronze, silver e gold).
  • Garantir a documentação técnica das soluções entregues.
  • Realizar transferência de conhecimento das implementações realizadas à equipe interna, quando aplicável.

title: Partnership Manager for Integrated Platforms
description:
About Ant International (Antom) Ant International is a global leader in digital payments and financial technology. Through our Antom brand, we empower merchants worldwide to connect with over one billion consumers via seamless, secure, and innovative payment solutions. We are driven by the mission to use technology to provide inclusive financial services for individuals and small businesses globally.

The Opportunity Are you ready to shape the future of digital commerce? Ant International is looking for a strategic and high-impact Partnership for Integrated Platform to drive our expansion in Brazil. In this role, you will be a key driver of Antom's growth, identifying prospecting opportunities and building the foundational partnerships that will scale our presence in one of the world's most exciting fintech markets.

Key Responsibilities: What You'll Do

  • Partnership Development & Sales Ownership: Work with various types of partners and platforms to actively identify, prospect, develop, and close key partnerships, leading and owning the full sales process.
  • Revenue & Growth: Consistently acquire new partners and drive revenue through efficient partnerships management, ensuring agreements are closed in a timely manner.
  • Market Intelligence & Networking: Stay informed on all relevant industry trends, the competitive landscape, and customer needs, representing the company at various industry trade shows, conferences, and networking events.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with partners and internal teams to manage expectations. Work closely with technical implementation and product teams to deliver solutions based on customer needs.
  • Onboarding & Client Experience: Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to ensure clients are on-boarded as quickly as possible while maintaining an excellent client experience.

Who You Are: Required Skills

  • Experience: 8+ years of working inside TOP BR platforms or PSPs managing partnerships.
  • Networking Skills: Strong networking skills with an active network at C-level with international trade merchants within Brazil.
  • Proven Track Record: Success in delivering complex integrated sales and a history of being a relentless new business hunter with an exceptional track record of overachievement.
  • Strategic Thinking: Sharp strategic thinker who can think outside the box and adapt to fast-paced, high-growth, and complex sales cycles.
  • Sales Methodology: Knowledge of consultative/solution sales process and experience with the "Challenger" approach, including buyer profiling and risk assessment.
  • Relationship Management: Strong experience in developing and maintaining global, cultural, and long-term client relationships that sustain results.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese and full professional English proficiency. Mandarin is a strong plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree in Business/Finance.
  • An extensive network across Brazilian financial institutions and major retailers.

Why Join Ant International?

At Ant International, we thrive on innovation and global connectivity. You'll be joining a team of builders who are redefining how the world pays and does business. If you are a visionary leader with a passion for the fintech revolution, we want to meet you.

Apply today and help us build a more inclusive financial future.

title: Analista de Suporte Protheus Pleno
description:
Prestar o suporte técnico aos nossos clientes provendo soluções com empatia, proatividade e

garantindo a satisfação dos clientes com os produtos e serviços TOTVS.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Realizar o atendimento aos clientes, por meio dos canais TOTVS, esclarecendo suas dúvidas sobre assuntos de média/alta complexidade referente ao sistema, registrando sugestões e incidentes;
  • Prestar o atendimento, por meio de canais de abertura de tickets, de acordo com o processo definido e visando ao atendimento e às metas estabelecidas;
  • Registrar, em sistema, a solicitação do cliente com todas as evidências (tickets abertos) de detalhamento necessárias para todos os impactados;
  • Triar os tickets abertos pelo cliente e reclassificá-los ou categorizá-los, quando necessário, pelo tipo de ticket ou status do atendimento;
  • Fornecer status das demandas em evolução, quando solicitado pelo cliente, por meio de canais de atendimento (telefônico, por e-mail, sistema);
  • Escalonar, para o próximo nível, as solicitações ou incidentes que não forem evoluídos, após o esgotamento das possibilidades de solução dentro do tempo estimado pela Coordenação da área;
  • Contribuir tanto para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, pesquisa de satisfação e outros) quanto para o resultado/metas da área;
  • Alertar a coordenação e atuar em potenciais riscos ou crises em clientes;
  • Manter atualizados FAQs/banco de conhecimento com as soluções definidas e repassadas aos clientes;
  • Apoiar nos processos de melhorias, detectando novas soluções, identificando problemas e questões relevantes.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Sólido conhecimento em rotinas fiscais (SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, EFD-Reinf, Apuração de Tributos, obrigações acessórias estaduais e federais).
  • Domínio nas parametrizações e configurações do módulo Fiscal do ERP Protheus.
  • Conhecimento de legislações tributárias e sua aplicação no ERP.
  • Habilidade para leitura e interpretação de manuais técnicos e legislação fiscal.
  • Noções de banco de dados (SQL), estrutura de tabelas e relacionamento entre módulos.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de atendimento e gestão de chamados (ex: Jira/Zendesk).

SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Experiência com clientes de atendimento Prime ou ambientes com alto grau de exigência e criticidade.
  • Conhecimento em SmartView, Configurador de Tributos, TSS e TAF.
  • Familiaridade com debug e análise de fontes no Protheus.
  • Certificações TOTVS serão consideradas um diferencial.

Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.

Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).

Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation, including working with large‐scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‐omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix, Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams

Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‐Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‐cell RNA‐seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‐modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‐Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‐preserving learning

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)

Evaluation Process:

  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.

Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).

Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation, including working with large‐scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‐omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix, Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams

Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‐Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‐cell RNA‐seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‐modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‐Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‐preserving learning

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)

Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Customer Success (CS) -
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional dedicado(a) e orientado(a) para Customer Success (CS), que desempenhará um papel fundamental na implementação e no sucesso contínuo dos Operadores Turísticos no Marketplace de Tours, Atividades e Atrações da tur.com no Brasil. -->

O(a) CS será responsável por orientar novos Vendors no uso eficaz da nossa plataforma, garantindo sua satisfação, crescimento e fidelização. Atuará como ponte entre os times de Produto, Vendas e Suporte, contribuindo diretamente para a melhoria da experiência de pós-venda.

Responsabilidades

Implementação e Treinamento

● Coordenar a implementação de novos Vendors, garantindo uma transição fluida desde a assinatura do contrato até a ativação no Marketplace.

● Oferecer treinamentos detalhados sobre o uso da plataforma, assegurando que os Operadores Turísticos compreendam todas as funcionalidades disponíveis.

Suporte Contínuo

● Atuar como principal ponto de contato para os Vendors, prestando suporte contínuo e solucionando dúvidas ou problemas.

● Monitorar o desempenho dos Vendors na plataforma e fornecer recomendações para melhorar sua presença e aumentar as vendas.

● Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Atendimento ao Cliente para resolver problemas oriundos dos clientes finais e coordenar ajustes necessários com os Operadores Turísticos.

Sucesso do Vendor

● Desenvolver estratégias personalizadas para melhorar o desempenho de cada Vendor, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e otimização.

● Coletar feedback e colaborar com o time de Produto para aprimorar funcionalidades-chave.

Requisitos

● Experiência prévia em Customer Success, preferencialmente no setor de turismo ou áreas relacionadas.

● Idiomas: Espanhol e Português. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.

● Capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas dos Operadores Turísticos e desenvolver soluções personalizadas.

● Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais, conforme a necessidade do cliente.

● Perfil orientado a resultados, com histórico de garantir o sucesso dos clientes.

● Conhecimento básico de plataformas CRM e ferramentas de atendimento ao cliente.

Oferecemos

● Salário competitivo.

● Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inovador e colaborativo.

● Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por garantir o sucesso dos clientes, trabalhar em equipe e contribuir para o crescimento do nosso Marketplace, te convidamos a se juntar a nós!

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional dedicado(a) e orientado(a) para Customer Success (CS), que desempenhará um papel fundamental na implementação e no sucesso contínuo dos Operadores Turísticos no Marketplace de Tours, Atividades e Atrações da tur.com no Brasil. -->

O(a) CS será responsável por orientar novos Vendors no uso eficaz da nossa plataforma, garantindo sua satisfação, crescimento e fidelização. Atuará como ponte entre os times de Produto, Vendas e Suporte, contribuindo diretamente para a melhoria da experiência de pós-venda.

Responsabilidades

Implementação e Treinamento

● Coordenar a implementação de novos Vendors, garantindo uma transição fluida desde a assinatura do contrato até a ativação no Marketplace.

● Oferecer treinamentos detalhados sobre o uso da plataforma, assegurando que os Operadores Turísticos compreendam todas as funcionalidades disponíveis.

Suporte Contínuo

● Atuar como principal ponto de contato para os Vendors, prestando suporte contínuo e solucionando dúvidas ou problemas.

● Monitorar o desempenho dos Vendors na plataforma e fornecer recomendações para melhorar sua presença e aumentar as vendas.

● Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Atendimento ao Cliente para resolver problemas oriundos dos clientes finais e coordenar ajustes necessários com os Operadores Turísticos.

Sucesso do Vendor

● Desenvolver estratégias personalizadas para melhorar o desempenho de cada Vendor, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e otimização.

● Coletar feedback e colaborar com o time de Produto para aprimorar funcionalidades-chave.

Requisitos

● Experiência prévia em Customer Success, preferencialmente no setor de turismo ou áreas relacionadas.

● Idiomas: Espanhol e Português. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.

● Capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas dos Operadores Turísticos e desenvolver soluções personalizadas.

● Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais, conforme a necessidade do cliente.

● Perfil orientado a resultados, com histórico de garantir o sucesso dos clientes.

● Conhecimento básico de plataformas CRM e ferramentas de atendimento ao cliente.

Oferecemos

● Salário competitivo.

● Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inovador e colaborativo.

● Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por garantir o sucesso dos clientes, trabalhar em equipe e contribuir para o crescimento do nosso Marketplace, te convidamos a se juntar a nós!

O(a) CS será responsável por orientar novos Vendors no uso eficaz da nossa plataforma, garantindo sua satisfação, crescimento e fidelização. Atuará como ponte entre os times de Produto, Vendas e Suporte, contribuindo diretamente para a melhoria da experiência de pós-venda.

Responsabilidades

Implementação e Treinamento

● Coordenar a implementação de novos Vendors, garantindo uma transição fluida desde a assinatura do contrato até a ativação no Marketplace.

● Oferecer treinamentos detalhados sobre o uso da plataforma, assegurando que os Operadores Turísticos compreendam todas as funcionalidades disponíveis.

Suporte Contínuo

● Atuar como principal ponto de contato para os Vendors, prestando suporte contínuo e solucionando dúvidas ou problemas.

● Monitorar o desempenho dos Vendors na plataforma e fornecer recomendações para melhorar sua presença e aumentar as vendas.

● Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Atendimento ao Cliente para resolver problemas oriundos dos clientes finais e coordenar ajustes necessários com os Operadores Turísticos.

Sucesso do Vendor

● Desenvolver estratégias personalizadas para melhorar o desempenho de cada Vendor, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e otimização.

● Coletar feedback e colaborar com o time de Produto para aprimorar funcionalidades-chave.

Requisitos

● Experiência prévia em Customer Success, preferencialmente no setor de turismo ou áreas relacionadas.

● Idiomas: Espanhol e Português. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.

● Capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas dos Operadores Turísticos e desenvolver soluções personalizadas.

● Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais, conforme a necessidade do cliente.

● Perfil orientado a resultados, com histórico de garantir o sucesso dos clientes.

● Conhecimento básico de plataformas CRM e ferramentas de atendimento ao cliente.

Oferecemos

● Salário competitivo.

● Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inovador e colaborativo.

● Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por garantir o sucesso dos clientes, trabalhar em equipe e contribuir para o crescimento do nosso Marketplace, te convidamos a se juntar a nós!

title: Gestor de vendas
description:
Sobre a WiteGroup

A WiteGroup é um ecossistema de tecnologia com foco em infraestrutura de pagamentos e marketing digital especializado em vendas online.

Atuamos conectando marketing, operação e soluções financeiras com alto nível de controle, estabilidade e responsabilidade sobre receita.

A WiteTec, braço tecnológico do grupo, é especializada em subadquirência, integrações com adquirentes, soluções BaaS (Bank as a Service) e estruturas robustas para operações digitais de alto volume.

Nosso foco é execução, processo e resultado mensurável.

⸻

2. Sobre a posição

Buscamos um Head Comercial / Gestor de Vendas com experiência sólida no mercado de pagamentos digitais.

Este profissional será responsável por liderar toda a estrutura comercial da WiteTec, garantindo organização de pipeline, previsibilidade de metas e crescimento estruturado da operação.

Não buscamos apenas um vendedor experiente.

Buscamos um líder comercial com visão estratégica, domínio técnico do ecossistema digital e capacidade real de gestão de equipe.

Esta é uma posição de liderança com impacto direto na expansão da WiteGroup.

⸻

3. Experiência Obrigatória

• Vivência comprovada em:

• Subadquirência

• Adquirência

• BaaS (Bank as a Service)

• Gateways de pagamento

• Infraestrutura de vendas online

• Conhecimento prático sobre:

• Taxa de aprovação

• Antifraude

• Estrutura de adquirentes

• D+2, D+15

• Split de pagamento

• Gestão de risco

• Operação financeira digital

• Experiência anterior liderando times comerciais.

⸻

4. Especialidade Técnica Fundamental

O profissional deve possuir domínio sólido em:

• Marketing digital aplicado a vendas

• Estruturação de funis (topo, meio e fundo)

• CAC, CPL, LTV e conversão

• Estrutura de tráfego pago (Meta Ads, Google Ads etc.)

• Diagnóstico de gargalos comerciais

• Estratégia de aquisição previsível

Além disso, deve compreender profundamente:

• Como opera um SDR

• Como negocia um Closer

• Como atua um Gerente de Contas

• Como estruturar metas e indicadores

• Como organizar pipeline e forecast

• Como transformar operação comercial em estrutura escalável

⸻

5. Responsabilidades

• Liderar o time comercial (SDRs, Closers e Account Managers)

• Estruturar metas mensais e trimestrais

• Garantir organização e previsibilidade de performance

• Definir e acompanhar indicadores comerciais

• Organizar processo comercial com disciplina

• Implementar rotina estruturada de reuniões

• Conduzir negociações estratégicas com grandes contas

• Reportar resultados diretamente à diretoria

• Conduzir expansão estruturada da base ativa de clientes

⸻

6. Competências Comportamentais

• Alta responsabilidade com meta

• Maturidade executiva

• Comunicação firme e objetiva

• Capacidade analítica avançada

• Mentalidade de dono

• Liderança orientada por processo

• Foco em execução e entrega

⸻

7. Perfil que Buscamos

• Profissional com visão estratégica de longo prazo

• Capaz de estruturar crescimento escalável

• Que entenda o mercado de pagamentos além da superfície

• Que saiba construir e liderar times de alta performance

• Que sustente responsabilidade real sobre receita

⸻

8. Perfil que Não Buscamos

• Gestor que apenas repassa metas

• Profissional sem vivência real no mercado de pagamentos

• Perfil dependente exclusivamente de script

• Líder sem domínio técnico do digital

• Profissional que transfere responsabilidade para o produto

Vaga afirmativa.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Decskill was founded in 2014 as an IT Consulting Company and their main mission is to delivery value through the knowledge. We enable companies to meet the chalenges of digital world by providing our clients with business models that ensure technological capacity, flexibility and agility. We are more than 500 consultants with offices in Lisbon, Porto and Madrid.

DECSKILL operates in 3 main areas:

• DECSKILL TALENT, through which we provide our clients with an extension to their IT teams;

• DECSKILL BOOST, through which we provide our client with software development models to increase capacity and optimize Time-to-Market, where we create and manage teams that deliver according to their needs, at the desired speed;

• DECSKILL CONNECT, through which we provide our client with consulting services, as well as the implementation and management of information technology infrastructures.

Our practice results in the creation of value for our customers, either by delivering qualified and value-added services, or through highly qualified and motivated professionals, as well as technology solutions that allow us to operate and transform the business of our customers.

We are looking for a Full-stack Ruby on Rails Engineer for a remote project in Brazil.

What we're looking for:

● The Tech: Strong experience delivering full-stack solutions using Ruby on Rails.

● The Domain: Experience with integrations across eCommerce platforms, marketplaces, or ERP systems, particularly operations and finance-focused.

● The Deliverables: Ability to complete scoped tasks independently, produce clean, tested code, and collaborate with stakeholders to meet project milestones.

What you'll do:

● Develop high-quality, performant Ruby on Rails code for specific project features.

● Participate in peer code reviews and provide constructive feedback as needed.

● Conduct testing and support deployments within a defined scope.

● Provide short-term post-deployment support (timeboxed) to address critical issues.

● Contribute technical expertise for project-specific solutions; long-term architectural ownership is not required. Preferred

Qualifications:

● 5+ years of professional web application development experience with Ruby on Rails.

● Strong Rails, database, and cloud infrastructure fundamentals.

● Familiarity with eCommerce/ERP integrations is a plus.

● Comfortable working independently and delivering on project milestones.

If you're interested in this job please send your CV in English to with reference "DA/Ruby".

Decskill is committed to equality and non-discrimination with all our talents. We recruit and promote talent, based on diversity and inclusion, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, race, nationality or any other form of discrimination incompatible with the dignity of the human being.

We enable companies to meet the chalenges of digital world by providing our clients with business models that ensure technological capacity, flexibility and agility. We are more than 500 consultants with offices in Lisbon, Porto and Madrid.

DECSKILL operates in 3 main areas:

• DECSKILL TALENT, through which we provide our clients with an extension to their IT teams;

• DECSKILL BOOST, through which we provide our client with software development models to increase capacity and optimize Time-to-Market, where we create and manage teams that deliver according to their needs, at the desired speed;

• DECSKILL CONNECT, through which we provide our client with consulting services, as well as the implementation and management of information technology infrastructures.

Our practice results in the creation of value for our customers, either by delivering qualified and value-added services, or through highly qualified and motivated professionals, as well as technology solutions that allow us to operate and transform the business of our customers.

We are looking for a Full-stack Ruby on Rails Engineer for a remote project in Brazil.

What we're looking for:

● The Tech: Strong experience delivering full-stack solutions using Ruby on Rails.

● The Domain: Experience with integrations across eCommerce platforms, marketplaces, or ERP systems, particularly operations and finance-focused.

● The Deliverables: Ability to complete scoped tasks independently, produce clean, tested code, and collaborate with stakeholders to meet project milestones.

What you'll do:

● Develop high-quality, performant Ruby on Rails code for specific project features.

● Participate in peer code reviews and provide constructive feedback as needed.

● Conduct testing and support deployments within a defined scope.

● Provide short-term post-deployment support (timeboxed) to address critical issues.

● Contribute technical expertise for project-specific solutions; long-term architectural ownership is not required. Preferred

Qualifications:

● 5+ years of professional web application development experience with Ruby on Rails.

● Strong Rails, database, and cloud infrastructure fundamentals.

● Familiarity with eCommerce/ERP integrations is a plus.

● Comfortable working independently and delivering on project milestones.

If you're interested in this job please send your CV in English to with reference "DA/Ruby".

Decskill is committed to equality and non-discrimination with all our talents. We recruit and promote talent, based on diversity and inclusion, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, race, nationality or any other form of discrimination incompatible with the dignity of the human being.

description:

O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Mínimo de 05 (cinco) anos de experiência comprovada na CTPS como engenheiro.

Atuar com Engenheiro de Materiais responsável por toda parte de suprimentos e logística da Unidade Operacional.

Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecânica, Metalúrgica, Produção ou Petróleo com certificado expedido por Instituição de Ensino reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC).

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.

This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.

To be more specific, you will:

  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.

The ideal profile

We're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.

You are someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it

You bring strong CM fundamentals:

  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms

You work well with others and think ahead:

  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process

  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!

What's in it for you

  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

MoveUp Media

We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.

With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!

Our approach

We focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.

Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.

This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.

To be more specific, you will:

  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.

The ideal profile

We're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.

You are someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it

You bring strong CM fundamentals:

  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms

You work well with others and think ahead:

  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process

  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!

What's in it for you

  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

MoveUp Media

We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.

With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!

Our approach

We focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.

Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados SR com forte capacidade técnica, visão analítica e foco em performance e governança de dados.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por dados, gosta de transformar complexidade em arquitetura escalável e quer atuar com pipelines robustos, Big Data e ambientes em nuvem, essa oportunidade é para você!

ATIVIDADES

Projetar, desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) em ambientes distribuídos

Orquestrar fluxos de dados utilizando Apache Airflow

Atuar com processamento de dados em larga escala com Apache Spark, Databricks e Scala

Desenvolver e implementar modelos de dados (MER, Star Schema, Snowflake)

Realizar extração, transformação e carga de dados com Python, SQL, Spark e Sqoop

Garantir versionamento e boas práticas com Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD e Terraform (IaC)

Manipular e otimizar ambientes em nuvem (AWS/Azure)

Atuar na melhoria de performance de scripts, queries e componentes de dados

Preparar dados para análises avançadas e modelagem preditiva

Desenvolver dashboards e apoiar storytelling com dados

Contribuir com arquitetura, padrões e documentação técnica

Apoiar áreas de negócio na priorização e entendimento de demandas estratégicas

REQUISITOS

Sólida experiência com modelagem de dados e arquitetura de Data Warehouse

Forte conhecimento em SQL, Python, Scala ou R

Experiência com Big Data (Spark, Databricks)

Vivência com orquestração de dados (Airflow)

Experiência com pipelines em ambientes Cloud (AWS e/ou Azure)

Conhecimento em versionamento (Git) e práticas DevOps

Experiência com Power BI ou ferramentas de visualização

Conhecimento em conceitos de Machine Learning

Domínio de ETL/ELT, BI, DW e arquitetura de dados

Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)

DIFERENCIAIS

Experiência com Terraform (Infraestrutura como Código)

Conhecimento em observabilidade de dados

Vivência com storytelling e comunicação executiva

Experiência em ambientes corporativos de alta complexidade

Certificações em Cloud (AWS/Azure)

Experiência com governança e qualidade de dados

Soft Skills que valorizamos

Trabalho em equipe e colaboração multidisciplinar

Perfil analítico e investigativo

Organização e atenção aos detalhes

Boa comunicação e capacidade de apresentar insights

Resiliência e proatividade

Modelo de Contratação: CLT Stefanini

Modelo de Atuação: 100% Remoto

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.

This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.

To be more specific, you will:

  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.

The ideal profile

We're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.

You are someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it

You bring strong CM fundamentals:

  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms

You work well with others and think ahead:

  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process

  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.

This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.

To be more specific, you will:

  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.

The ideal profile

We're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.

You are someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it

You bring strong CM fundamentals:

  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms

You work well with others and think ahead:

  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

title: Gerente comercial de vendas
description:
Estou assessorando empresa de grande porte, referência no canal Distribuidor de alimentos e com DNA de excelência e crescimento acelerado, busca um líder comercial estratégico para consolidar sua operação na região de Pinhais/Curitiba. Esta é uma oportunidade para quem busca alta performance e uma estrutura que premia resultados excepcionais.

Perfil Desejado

Buscamos um profissional com perfil \"hunter\", excelente trânsito na indústria e visão de negócio 360°.

  • Expertise Setorial: Experiência sólida e comprovada no canal distribuidor e relacionamento estratégico com a indústria.
  • Liderança: Experiência na gestão de equipes de vendas e atendimento a contas-chave (Key Accounts).
  • Mobilidade: Disponibilidade total para mudanças (será tido como diferencial crucial para o plano de carreira) e disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Formação: Ensino Superior Completo.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gerir e potencializar a equipe de vendas e grandes contas.
  • Estreitar o relacionamento entre a indústria e a distribuição, focando em expansão de share.
  • Gestão rigorosa de KPIs de performance e entrega de resultados.

Pacote de Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Fixo: Compatível com o nível de senioridade da função.
  • Variável de Alta Performance: Bônus por metas e KPIs que pode atingir até 6 salários anuais.

title: Terapeuta Vendedora
description:
A Caudalie é uma marca francesa de skincare, fundada em 1995, em Bordeaux, por Mathilde e Bertrand Thomas. Desenvolvemos produtos altamente eficazes a partir de ingredientes naturais extraídos da videira e da uva, sempre com foco em clean beauty, ciência e sustentabilidade.

Quem é você?

• Formação em estética ou áreas afins (cosmetologia, bio-medicina, massoterapia).

• Experiência Profissional: 1, 2 anos na área de estética

• Experiência em vendas

• Adota o uso de tecnologia como iPad, serviços de e-mail e telefone.

• Energia entusiasmada, amigável e positiva

• Capacidade excepcional de desenvolver relacionamentos, resolver problemas.

• Capacidade comprovada de definir e atingir metas

• Deve gostar de trabalhar com pessoas em um ambiente de equipe

Principais responsabilidades

• Realizar tratamentos faciais e corporais de acordo com o protocolo Caudalie.

• Capacidade excepcional de desenvolver clientela, relacionamentos fortes e influenciar clientes.

• Capacidade comprovada de atingir ou superar metas de vendas e expectativas de atendimento ao cliente.

• Conhecimento de produto/ingredientes e técnicas de aplicação.

• Apaixonada e enérgica por cuidados/beleza da pele com desejo de crescer dentro da marca.

• Demonstrar uma atitude enérgica e positiva, forte comunicação e habilidades interpessoais.

• Compreende a marca Caudalie, os ingredientes e os benefícios para o cliente.

• Capacidade de responder às dúvidas dos clientes sobre os serviços oferecidos e produtos utilizados e disponibilizados pela Caudalie.

• Compreende e utiliza precauções universais ao fornecer serviços, limpar e manter ferramentas e equipamentos de tratamento.

• Avaliar as necessidades dos clientes e identificar alergias e/ou quaisquer condições médicas que possam impactar os serviços e produtos utilizados.

• Manter uma estação de trabalho e cabine de tratamento limpas e organizadas, e trocar a roupa de cama.

• Monitorar e cumprir os cronogramas dos tratamentos realizados.

title: AI Data Annotation Specialist
description:
Job Role : AI Data Annotation Specialist

Location: Brazil

Work Type: Freelance / Project-based

About the Role

We are looking for Freelance Data Annotation Specialists with strong English proficiency to support global AI and Large Language Model (LLM) projects. This is a project-based freelancing opportunity, ideal for individuals seeking flexible work while contributing to cutting-edge AI development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Annotate and review text-based data following detailed project guidelines
  • Perform language-centric tasks such as classification, evaluation, and reasoning
  • Maintain high accuracy, consistency, and quality standards
  • Meet defined productivity benchmarks within project timelines
  • Flag unclear or ambiguous data as per escalation guidelines
  • Ensure confidentiality and compliance with data security requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Excellent English and Portuguese proficiency (written and spoken)
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote/project-based setup
  • Basic computer literacy and familiarity with online tools
  • Prior experience in data annotation, content review, or similar roles is a plus

Selection Process

Candidates must successfully clear the following assessments:

  • LLM Assessment
  • Versant English Assessment

Only candidates who pass both assessments will be eligible for Background Verification (BGV)

Additional Information

  • This is a freelancing role and does not include full-time employment benefits
  • Background verification is mandatory prior to onboarding
